grammar.summary: 本课学习表"磨损"的 wear out 与 be capable of doing。

points.title: be capable of doing 表能够
points.explanation: The body is capable of self-repair. capable of + V-ing = 有能力做；与 be able to do 的区别在介词搭配。

examples.en: Our bodies are capable of repairing themselves.
examples.cn: 我们的身体能够自我修复。

points.title: 表"逐渐"的 wear out 与 run down
points.explanation: The machine wears out over time. wear out = 磨损耗尽；run down = （能量）耗尽。机器隐喻贯穿全文。

examples.cn: 我们像机器一样逐渐磨损。
